reuse.why: The change reuses bank lookup, unlinking and transaction downloading, but duplicates the existing BankSyncProviders type.

duplication.why: Link policies and the Akahu/Fintegra downloader are shared, although six registration wrappers repeat orchestration and DbAccount repeats the provider union.

placement.why: The changes follow existing server layers, but provider-neutral linking belongs in a clearly shared function rather than a broadened Akahu handler.

scope.why: The edits remain focused on linking policies, Fintegra integration and supporting types and tests.

maintainability.why: Centralized policies help maintenance, but provider-specific branching inside linkAkahuAccount and duplicated registration orchestration obscure the shared linking contract.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/db/types/index.ts spells out provider literals instead of using the existing BankSyncProviders type.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining wrapper and provider-union duplication is explicit; the Fintegra downloader and linker delegate rather than disguise copied implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: linkAkahuAccount gains provider and two Fintegra-specific conditional expressions; unlinkAccount gains preserveProviderConnection and an early-return branch; the extracted downloader adds providerName and server parameters; all six registered link handlers use prepareBankAccountLink.
